learn_meta_descripcion: What to do after joining Vennett: build your strategy, when it locks and how to read the standings.
learn_lead: What to do and when. The full method is in <link>How it works</link>.
learn_paso_estrategia_nota: Start from a style or from a sentence.
learn_ayuda: Anything unclear? Write to us at <correo></correo>.
learn_g1_desc: On paper, against the S&P 500, and who the house is.
learn_g1_lead: Paper investment strategies competing against the S&P 500. No real money is involved.
learn_g1_ano_d: Each matchday lasts a month and awards points, but luck weighs a lot in a single month. That is why the standings go by the season's cumulative return, dividends included. Matchdays are the episodes.
learn_g1_indice_t: You play against the index and against people
learn_g1_indice_d: Your strategy is always measured against the S&P 500 over the same period. The standings rank it against the rest.
learn_g1_omega_d: Follows market momentum. Its portfolio changes during the month.
learn_g1_lambda_d: No rules: the companies with the best score of the month.
learn_g1_casa_nota: Same S&P, same points and same scores as you.
learn_g2_desc: The five steps of the editor.
learn_g2_lead: Five steps in the editor. It saves itself while you work.
learn_g2_idea_d: Pick a style, such as “Quality at a fair price”, or write your idea in your own words.
learn_g2_reglas_d: Each rule filters companies out. As you move a threshold you see how many remain.
learn_g2_criterios_d: Decide how much each score counts: fundamentals, valuation, financing and catalyst.
learn_g2_cartera_d: The companies that would make it in today, with the reason for each one.
learn_g2_revisar_d: Give it a name and a crest. “Save and enter” puts it in the next matchday.
learn_g2_pasan: companies with ROE above {umbral}%, out of {total}
learn_g2_fuente: Real count from the latest snapshot, with this rule only.
learn_g3_desc: When everything locks, in your time.
learn_g3_lead: On the last trading day of each month one matchday closes and the next one starts. This is the next one, in your time.
learn_g3_escaneo_d: Every company is analysed and gets its scores for the next matchday.
learn_g3_cierre_d: Its result is locked and never rewritten.
learn_g3_corte_d: The {mes} portfolio of every entered strategy is built.
learn_g3_ventana: Until changes close, you can remove companies from your portfolio and bring them back.
learn_g3_cambios_d: After that, the portfolio is locked for the whole month.
learn_g3_porque_d: Scores come out before portfolios lock, and nobody knows how the first day will move when the portfolio is locked. Every strategy plays with the same snapshot.
learn_g4_lead: Two views of the same list: by return or by matchdays won.
learn_g4_rent_d: The main view ranks by the season's cumulative return, dividends included.
learn_g4_puntos_intro: Each month, your strategy is compared with the S&P 500 over the same period.
learn_g4_puntos_d: More than {banda} points above: {gana}. Within {banda}: {empata}. Below: {pierde}.
learn_g4_jornadas_d: The other view ranks by points: who wins the most months, even though the season is decided by return.
learn_g4_provisional: While a matchday is still in play, positions are provisional.
learn_g5_desc: How much, for whom and with what requirements.
learn_g5_lead: A cash prize at the end of the season for the top three. Free, and not a draw.
learn_g5_sin: With fewer than {n}, there is no prize that season.
